description: This file defines classes and functions for managing browser targets, contexts, downloads, and related events within a Firefox environment, specifically for integration with Playwright. It includes handling of download interception, page and browser context management, permissions, cookies, and screencast functionalities.

classes.name: DownloadInterceptor
classes.description: Handles download request interception, creation, completion, and cancellation within the browser environment.

classes.name: TargetRegistry
classes.description: Manages browser targets, contexts, and events, facilitating page creation, navigation, and resource management.

classes.name: PageTarget
classes.description: Represents a page or tab within the browser, managing its lifecycle, settings, and interactions.

classes.name: BrowserContext
classes.description: Represents a browser context, managing permissions, cookies, proxies, and associated pages.

classes.name: Dialog
classes.description: Represents a modal dialog (alert, prompt, confirm) within a page.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TargetRegistry.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the TargetRegistry, sets up observers, and manages browser windows and tabs.

methods.name: newPage
methods.description: Creates a new page within a specified browser context.

methods.name: _newPageInternal
methods.description: Internal method to instantiate a new page and open a browser window.

methods.name: targets
methods.description: Returns an array of all current targets.

methods.name: targetForBrowser
methods.description: Retrieves the target associated with a specific browser object.

methods.name: targetForBrowserId
methods.description: Retrieves the target associated with a specific browser ID.
